messages:
maya: FYI starting bringup for zephyr-lite-8b (quant-int8) — running perf + quality triage today. low priority but want a quick sweep to see if it's viable for Dedicated.

leo: sgtm. can you paste the quick perf command you ran?

maya: ran the usual microbench: `./bench --model zephyr-lite-8b --quant int8 --batch 1,4,8 --seq 512,1024 --runs 50`

maya: quick raw: batch=1 seq=512 p50=18ms p95=45ms p99=92ms; batch=4 seq=512 p50=60ms p95=160ms p99=280ms -> surprised by p99.

perf-bot: automated-bench results uploaded: link: https://perf.redwood/bench/2712345678. summary: int8 throughput within expected envelope, high tail for batches >2 on seq>=512.

sophia: could be KV cache cold starts + scheduler jitter. did you warm up cache or use prefix cache?

maya: no warmup. quick smoke only. also did a qconfig with `per_channel=True` and `clip_threshold=0.02` per our last notes.

jack: try `--warmup 200 --cache-prefix 1` + use blocked batching (batch buckets [1,2,4]) to avoid stragglers. also capture `nvprof`/metrics.

leo: also want latency breakdown by stages (tokenization, forward, postprocess). can we get flops/allocs?

maya: capturing logs. adding a small profiler script:

maya: ```
python perf_probe.py --model zephyr-lite-8b --quant int8 --buckets 1,2,4 --seq 128,512,1024 --warmup 200 --runs 100 --trace stages
```

rachel: i can run the seq sweep on dedicated nvidia-p4 cluster later today. will run with and without `--kv-cache` and with blocked batching.

perf-bot: note: past models with similar arch showed ~2.4x p99 increase when mixing long sequences and unsteady batching. tickets: PERF-3481.

leo: regarding quality, any regen or hallucination regressions from quantization? maya?

maya: ran small eval set (100 prompts). token-level LM score delta -0.7, but a couple prompts show factual shifts. saving example transcripts to s3: s3://redwood/zephyr-lite/qual/2712345678/

sophia: can you attach the prompts? we should run a focused few-shot eval and rerun with `per_channel=False` and `qscheme='symmetric'` to compare.

maya: added eval-run to the bench queue and flagged 5 failing prompts in the ticket.

jack: checklist proposal for next 24h: 1) warmup + blocked batching run (owner: rachel) 2) detailed p99 stage trace (owner: leo) 3) quant config sweep per_channel True/False and clip variants (owner: sophia) 4) focused quality eval + diff report (owner: maya) 5) decision threshold: if int8 p99 > 3x fp16 or quality delta > 1.5 LM points -> gate (owner: eng-ml).

rachel: noted. starting runs now, will post artifacts (bench csv + flamegraphs). ETA ~4h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leo: if rachel sees stragglers, try `--concurrency 2` in runner to smooth scheduling.

maya: thanks everyone. i'll consolidate into the intake ticket and set a canary flag for Dedicated if green.

perf-bot: ticket created PERF-4692 and linked artifacts.

rachel: first pass results: blocked-batch reduces p99 by ~30% at batch=4 seq=512. uploading CSV.

maya: great. will review and pick quant config for wider smoke. will post final recommendation in ticket later today. :thumbsup:
